headline: Binance Pledges to Cover Losses After Multi-Billion Dollar Crypto Theft
summary: Binance pledged to cover all customer losses after an engineer's compromised laptop allowed attackers to breach hot wallets, draining between $5.8 billion and $8.9 billion. Tether, Circle, and exchanges froze over $3 billion.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Massive breaches disrupt liquidity, shake confidence in centralized custody, and put pressure on digital asset valuations.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Selling pressure and market panic following the disclosure of the historic exchange exploit drove token prices lower.
